prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1061
Claimant:
Jessica Chapman
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
14 Dec 2023
The claimant reported a rear-end collision in a parking lot and said they were struck while stopped at a row of parked
cars. They described hitting their head on the steering wheel and were advised to seek medical attention promptly.
1 Jan 2024
Reviewed the policy record and confirmed the driver involved is named on the policy. Coverage was in force at the
time of the reported loss, and nothing in the file suggests the vehicle damage predates the policy start.
7 Jan 2024
Called the claimant to take a recorded statement. Their account of the impact matched what was first reported,
including the direction of travel and the position of both vehicles.
27 Jan 2024
Police report obtained. Responding officers confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene. No independent
witnesses were identified in the report or during follow-up calls.
14 Feb 2024
Photos submitted by the claimant show the rear bumper and tailgate damage and some scuffing on the other vehicle.
The visible damage is largely consistent with the impact described, and I found no indication of earlier dmaage to the
vehicle in prior claim records.
20 May 2024
Medical records received for the concussion diagnosis. The injury type and severity fit the force of a collision of this
kind, and there is no record of prior injury to the head or neck area.
27 May 2024
Treatment followed a typical course, with early follow-up visits and a gradual reduction in appointments as symptoms
improved. The provider notes describe steady recovery over the period.
2 Aug 2024
Spoke with the claimant again. They repeated the same account of the collision and the symptoms they experienced,
with no changes to key details from any earlier conversation.
8 Aug 2024
Reviewed the full file. The reported injury and vehicle damage are consistent with the described incident, and the
claim is ready for the next stage of evaluation.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
